intro: Football is Bolivia's favourite sport, and its high-altitude stadiums are feared by visiting teams.

chapters.title: Football
text: Bolivia won the Copa América at home in 1963. Playing at 3,600 m in La Paz helps Bolivia beat stronger teams.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: Racquetball and the Dakar Rally route through the salt flats have also drawn attention.
